# Errors and advice codes

Every code the engine prints, as `[CODE] message`, with its fix. Each module registers its own codes with
`defineCodes` beside the code that raises them; tools/lib/docs.ts says how they are read.

## anim

### ANIM_ACTION_NO_CLIPS

- Message: `action {action} plays clips ({clips}), but its Actions has no clip layer`
- Fix: make it with one: new Actions({ clips }), the ClipLayer in the animator's clips slot, with the sets those clips come from
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/actions.ts` line 60](../engine/anim/actions.ts)

Thrown by `Actions.play` (engine/anim/actions.ts) for an action with a `clip` beat when the player was made without `clips`: the beat would play nothing, silently.

### ANIM_BAD_CHAIN

- Message: `a chain cannot have {field} {value}`
- Fix: give a chain n ≥ 2 points, seg > 0 metres and iterations ≥ 1
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/chain.ts` line 38](../engine/anim/chain.ts)

Thrown by `new Chain` and `new Cape` (engine/anim/secondary.ts) for fewer than 2 points, a segment that is not a positive length, or no constraint pass: such a chain has nothing to hang or never holds its length.

### ANIM_BAD_HIT_KEY

- Message: `hits keyed a target by {key}, not a finite number, so it could not tell the targets apart`
- Fix: give each target a numeric id field, or pass hits a fourth argument that returns one: (t) => t.entity
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/attack.ts` line 36](../engine/anim/attack.ts)

Thrown by `Attack.hits` and `Combo.hits` (engine/anim/attack.ts), which hit each target once per swing by its key: its `id` field, or what the keying function given returns. Targets without one would all share the key `undefined`, so only the first would ever be hit.

### ANIM_BAD_LAYER

- Message: `layer {name}: {problem}`
- Fix: give each layer its own name and one of the slots {slots}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/character.ts` line 53](../engine/anim/character.ts)

Raised by `Animator.use` (engine/anim/character.ts) for a slot that takes no layers or a name already in use.

### ANIM_BAD_MASK

- Message: `the bone mask weight of {name} is {value}`
- Fix: give each weight a number from 0 to 1
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/skeleton.ts` line 37](../engine/anim/skeleton.ts)

Raised by `boneMask` (engine/anim/skeleton.ts) for a weight that is not a number from 0 to 1.

### ANIM_BAD_STATE

- Message: `body state {name} is {value}, not {expected}{suggestion}; it is ignored`
- Fix: give {name} {expected}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/states.ts` line 42](../engine/anim/states.ts)

Raised once per word by the animator (engine/anim/character.ts `step`, through `checkBodyStates`) for a body state whose value is of the wrong kind: a number for `dash`, a trail that does not exist. `BODY_STATES` (engine/anim/states.ts) gives each word its kind. Raised once too by a humanoid playing a move told in `body` (engine/anim/strike.ts `stepArm`) whose phase is not wind, active or recover, or whose share `u` is not finite: data or the console, which TypeScript does not check; the move does not play.

### ANIM_BAD_TARGET

- Message: `the {what} given to {solver} is ({x}, {y}, {z})`
- Fix: pass finite world coordinates in metres
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/ik.ts` line 41](../engine/anim/ik.ts)

Raised by the IK solvers (engine/anim/ik.ts) for a target, pole or grip with a coordinate that is NaN or infinite, which would spread NaN through the pose.

### ANIM_CLIP_ANGLE_RANGE

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}): "{field}" holds {value}°, past ±540°`
- Fix: take whole turns (360) off it, keeping it near the keys round it; normalizedLens(clip) shows every angle folded to ±180°
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 126](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_BAD_FIELD

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}): "{field}" is {value}`
- Fix: make "{field}" {shape}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 94](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_BAD_HEADER

- Message: `{where}: "{field}" is {value}`
- Fix: make "{field}" {shape}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 102](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

Raised by `parseClip` and `parseClipSet` (engine/anim/clip/validate.ts) for a clip or set header field of the wrong type or shape, and for a clip whose `src` is not one of its set’s sources.

### ANIM_CLIP_BAD_KEY

- Message: `{where}: key {key} is {value}, not a key pose`
- Fix: write each key as an object holding "t" (seconds) and the fields LEGEND lists (engine/anim/clip/lens.ts)
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 82](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_BELOW_FLOOR

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}): the hips are at {value}% of standing hip height, below the floor`
- Fix: raise hips[2] to 0 or more (100 is standing, 55 sitting on a chair)
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 130](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_KNEE_RANGE

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}): "{field}" {problem}`
- Fix: keep the knee bend from 0 to 165 and, while it bends more than 30, its twist within 120 of forward
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 122](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_LIMB_COLLAPSE

- Message: `{where}: "{field}" turns {angle}° between key {key} (t {t}) and key {next} (t {nextT})`
- Fix: add a key between them pointing the way the limb should swing: in-betweens of opposite directions pass through the joint
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 111](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

Reported by `validateClip` (engine/anim/clip/validate.ts) when a limb direction turns more than 150° from one key to the next: keys in-between every number linearly, so the direction nearly vanishes on the way and the limb snaps round.

### ANIM_CLIP_MISSING_FIELD

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}) has no "{field}"`
- Fix: add "{field}": {shape}; every key needs hips, body, chest, head, armL, armR, legL and legR
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 90](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_NO_KEYS

- Message: `{where} has no key poses`
- Fix: give it "keys": [ … ] with at least one key pose, each { "t": seconds, "hips": [0, 0, 100], … }
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 78](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_NO_TIME

- Message: `{where}: key {key} has no time "t"`
- Fix: give every key its time in seconds from the start of the clip, such as "t": 0.5
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 86](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_NOT_JSON

- Message: `{where} is not JSON: {problem}`
- Fix: write the clip as JSON (lines starting with // are comments): { "dur": seconds, "loop": false, "keys": [ … ] }
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 74](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_TWIST_POP

- Message: `{where}: "{field}" twist jumps {jump}° between key {key} (t {t}) and key {next} (t {nextT}) while bent {bend}°`
- Fix: add or subtract 360 so the twist continues from the key before, or add a key between them
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 116](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

Reported by `validateClip` (engine/anim/clip/validate.ts) for a twist that changes more than 120° between keys while either key bends the limb more than 140°: the elbow or knee spins round the limb (the v1 pop pattern).

### ANIM_CLIP_UNKNOWN_FIELD

- Message: `{where}: key {key} (t {t}) has no field "{field}"{suggestion}`
- Fix: use only the key fields {fields} (LEGEND, in engine/anim/clip/lens.ts, says what each means)
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 98](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_CLIP_UNKNOWN_HEADER

- Message: `{where} has no field "{field}"{suggestion}`
- Fix: use only the fields {fields}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/validate.ts` line 107](../engine/anim/clip/validate.ts)

### ANIM_EMPTY_COMBO

- Message: `a Combo was made from no moves, so it has no hit to play`
- Fix: pass Combo at least one move (an id such as "jab", a Move, a spec or an Attack); check a list read from data before making the combo
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/attack.ts` line 41](../engine/anim/attack.ts)

Thrown by `new Combo(moves)` (engine/anim/attack.ts) when `moves` is empty: `press`, `current`, `save` and `load` all play or read one of its hits.

### ANIM_LAYER_BUILD

- Message: `the clip layer measures paces and root motion on {layer}, but its animator plays {animator}`
- Fix: make the layer with the animator's build: new ClipLayer({ library, build: animator.body.build })
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/library.ts` line 52](../engine/anim/clip/library.ts)

Raised by the clip layer (engine/anim/clip/layer.ts) when it poses an animator of another build. The sim’s step measures walk paces and root motion on the layer’s own build, so on another one they would be off by the hip-height ratio and the feet would slide.

### ANIM_NO_REST

- Message: `set {set} has no rest body for clip {name} (source {src})`
- Fix: give the set a sources entry for that source, with the rest body its importer measured
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/library.ts` line 47](../engine/anim/clip/library.ts)

Raised by the clip library (engine/anim/clip/library.ts) when a clip names a source the set lacks, or the set has no sources: a clip decodes only on the rest body it was measured on.

### ANIM_NOT_PRECISE

- Message: `strikeSegment was given an animator without preciseHits: its pose is the view’s, not the sim’s`
- Fix: make the animator (an actor’s anim) with preciseHits: true, so the sim poses it every tick; or pass a Humanoid the sim updates itself
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/moves.ts` line 41](../engine/anim/moves.ts)

Thrown by `strikeSegment` (engine/anim/moves.ts) for an `Animator` without `preciseHits`. A strike’s span is read from a pose, and the sim poses only animators with `preciseHits` (engine/sim/actors.ts, the system `actors.pose`); any other animator holds whatever the view last drew, nothing headless, so hits read from it would depend on rendering and visibility.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_BEAT

- Message: `action {action} has no beat {name}{suggestion}`
- Fix: go to one of its beats: {names}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/actions.ts` line 55](../engine/anim/actions.ts)

Thrown by `Actions.go` (engine/anim/actions.ts) for a beat name the playing action lacks, or when nothing plays. The message names the closest beats.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_CLIP

- Message: `set {set} has no clip {name}{suggestion}`
- Fix: use one of its clips (library.names lists them; a page's library may need that set loaded)
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/clip/library.ts` line 42](../engine/anim/clip/library.ts)

Raised by the clip library and the clip layer (engine/anim/clip/library.ts, layer.ts) for a clip name the loaded sets lack. The message names the closest names.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_JOINT

- Message: `{name} is not a {what} of the humanoid skeleton{suggestion}`
- Fix: use one of: {names}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/skeleton.ts` line 32](../engine/anim/skeleton.ts)

Raised by `jointIndex`, `socketIndex`, `boneMask` and the pose functions that take a joint (engine/anim/) for a name the skeleton lacks, or a joint index outside 0–22. The message names the closest names; `JOINTS`, `SOCKETS` and `MASKS` list them all.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_POINT

- Message: `the rigid pair names {name}, which is not a joint, a socket or the root{suggestion}`
- Fix: name joints (JOINTS), sockets (SOCKETS) or "root" in rigid pairs
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/check.ts` line 62](../engine/anim/check.ts)

Raised by `animCheck` (engine/anim/check.ts) for a rigid pair naming a point the skeleton lacks.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_POSE

- Message: `{name} is not a humanoid {what}{suggestion}; it is ignored`
- Fix: use one of: {names}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/poses.ts` line 51](../engine/anim/poses.ts)

Raised once per name by the humanoid (engine/anim/humanoid.ts) for a `pose`, `stance` or `weapon` it does not know. The message names the closest names; `POSES`, `STANCES` and `WEAPONS` (engine/anim/poses.ts) list them all. An unknown weapon holds nothing.

### ANIM_UNKNOWN_STATE

- Message: `{name} is not a body state{suggestion}; it is ignored`
- Fix: use one of: {names}
- Registered in: [`engine/anim/states.ts` line 37](../engine/anim/states.ts)

Raised once per word by the animator (engine/anim/character.ts `step`, through `checkBodyStates`) for a body state outside the vocabulary, usually a typo. The message names the closest words; `BODY_STATES` (engine/anim/states.ts) lists them all.

### APP_BAD_ROUTE

### APP_STORE_BLOCKED

- Message: `the page refused its storage ({reason}), so the store {prefix} keeps its values in memory for this page only`
- Fix: allow the site's storage (a private window or a blocked cookie setting refuses it); the game still runs, and forgets on reload
- Registered in: [`engine/app/store.ts` line 43](../engine/app/store.ts)

Advice from the store (engine/app/store.ts), once: `localStorage` threw when touched, so nothing is kept across sessions.

### APP_STORE_VERSION

- Message: `the store {prefix} holds {key} at {found}; this game reads version {version}`
- Fix: give createStore a migrate(data, version) that turns the old value into the current one, or let the reader fall back to its default (the old value stays until set replaces it)
- Registered in: [`engine/app/store.ts` line 38](../engine/app/store.ts)

Advice from the store (engine/app/store.ts), once per key: a kept value written in another format or version is not handed back as it is.

## audio

### AUDIO_BAD_NOTE

- Message: `{where}: "{note}" is not a note`
- Fix: write a frequency in Hz or a note name: a letter A–G, then # or b, then the octave (A4 = 440 Hz, C#5, Bb2)
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts` line 47](../engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts)

Raised by `noteFreq` and `render` (engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts, render.ts) for a pitch that is neither a positive number nor a note name.

### AUDIO_BAD_OPTION

- Message: `{option} is {value}, not {expected}`
- Fix: pass {expected} as {option}
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/runtime/sound.ts` line 29](../engine/audio/runtime/sound.ts)

Raised by `audio.play` and `Sound.move` (engine/audio/runtime/sound.ts) for a volume, pitch, variant or position out of range.

### AUDIO_BAD_RATE

- Message: `the sample rate {rate} is not a whole number from 8000 to 192000`
- Fix: render at a whole number of samples per second from 8000 to 192000, usually 44100 or 48000
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/render.ts` line 38](../engine/audio/dsp/render.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts).

### AUDIO_BAD_ROOM

- Message: `room {room} is not a preset{hint}`
- Fix: name one of the ROOMS presets ({names}), or pass { decay, predelay, damping, wet }
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/runtime/reverb.ts` line 28](../engine/audio/runtime/reverb.ts)

Raised by `impulseResponse` and `audio.room` (engine/audio/runtime/reverb.ts) for a room name that is not in `ROOMS`, or numbers out of range.

### AUDIO_BAD_SEED

- Message: `the seed {seed} is not a whole number`
- Fix: pass a whole number as the seed, such as one drawn with rng.int
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/render.ts` line 43](../engine/audio/dsp/render.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts): seeds name random streams exactly, so 1.5 is refused rather than silently rounded.

### AUDIO_BAD_VALUE

- Message: `{where}: {field} is {value}`
- Fix: make {field} {rule}
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts` line 42](../engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts) for a value of the wrong type or outside its range, and for fields that do not apply to the voice (a pitch change on a pluck, fm on noise).

### AUDIO_BAD_VARIANT

- Message: `{id} has variants 0 to {last}; {variant} is not one of them`
- Fix: ask for a whole number from 0 to {last}, or give the effect more variants
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/data/sfx.ts` line 51](../engine/audio/data/sfx.ts)

Raised by `renderSfx` (engine/audio/data/sfx.ts).

### AUDIO_LAYER_CYCLE

- Message: `{id} contains itself through its layers: {path}`
- Fix: remove one layer of the cycle: a layer mixes another effect in, which cannot contain the first
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/data/sfx.ts` line 46](../engine/audio/data/sfx.ts)

Raised by `sfxVoices` and `renderSfx` (engine/audio/data/sfx.ts) when following layers leads back to an effect already on the path.

### AUDIO_OFF

- Message: `sound is off: {reason}`
- Fix: open the page in a browser with Web Audio (every current one has it); the game runs on in silence
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/runtime/audio.ts` line 55](../engine/audio/runtime/audio.ts)

Advice from `createAudio` (engine/audio/runtime/audio.ts) when there is no Web Audio, or the context could not be made.

### AUDIO_TOO_LONG

- Message: `the sound lasts {seconds} s, past the {max} s limit`
- Fix: shorten its voices (at, dur) or its echo (delay.time, delay.feedback); a song renders section by section
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/render.ts` line 48](../engine/audio/dsp/render.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts) before it allocates the buffer.

### AUDIO_UNKNOWN_FIELD

- Message: `{where} has no field "{field}"{suggestion}`
- Fix: use only the fields {fields}
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts` line 37](../engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts) for a field a voice, filter, fm, pluck or delay does not have: usually a typo, which would otherwise be silently ignored.

### AUDIO_UNKNOWN_WAVE

- Message: `{where}: there is no wave "{wave}"{suggestion}`
- Fix: use one of {waves}
- Registered in: [`engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts` line 32](../engine/audio/dsp/voice.ts)

Raised by `render` (engine/audio/dsp/render.ts) when a voice names a wave the DSP does not make.

## core

### CORE_BAD_CODE

- Message: `{problem}`
- Fix: register each code once, beside the code that raises it: defineCodes('<area>', { AREA_NAME: { template, fix, doc } }), the name in upper-case words starting with the area's
- Registered in: [`engine/core/log.ts` line 55](../engine/core/log.ts)

Raised by `defineCodes` (engine/core/log.ts) for an area that is not one lower-case word, a code that does not start with its area, a template or fix that is empty, or a code registered again with other text. `x docs --check` reports the same problems statically.

### CORE_BAD_COLOR

- Message: `color {color} is not a hex color`
- Fix: write colours as hex strings: '#rrggbb' (or '#rgb', '#rgba', '#rrggbbaa')
- Registered in: [`engine/core/color.ts` line 28](../engine/core/color.ts)

Raised by the colour helpers (engine/core/color.ts) for a string that is not hex. Colours are hex strings in data (PLAN.md §6.3); names such as `red` and `rgb()` forms are not accepted, so a typo fails where it is read instead of drawing the wrong colour.

### CORE_BAD_KIND

- Message: `kind {kind}: {problem}`
- Fix: declare each kind once, as defineKind('<kind>', { description, fields, fallback?, check?, defineWith? }), the name a lower-case word (camelCase allowed)
- Registered in: [`engine/core/registry.ts` line 53](../engine/core/registry.ts)

Raised by `defineKind` (engine/core/registry.ts) for a malformed name, a kind declared twice, a missing description, or a key the declaration does not take. Problems inside `fields` raise `CORE_BAD_SCHEMA`.

### CORE_BAD_NOISE

- Message: `noise option {option} must be {rule}, got {value}`
- Fix: pass createNoise2D/createNoise3D a kind of value, gradient or cell, octaves from 1 to 16, a finite gain, a positive lacunarity (an integer when period is set) and a period that is a positive integer, or none
- Registered in: [`engine/core/noise.ts` line 35](../engine/core/noise.ts)

Raised when a noise is created (engine/core/noise.ts), never while it is sampled, so a bad option fails at once instead of giving a noise that silently stops tiling.

### CORE_BAD_SCHEMA

- Message: `{where}: {problems}`
- Fix: write each field as { type, description, default?, required?, minimum?, maximum?, enum?, unit?, items?, properties?, when?, view? } (engine/core/schema.ts), with a default that passes its own checks, and a default for every hook that is not required
- Registered in: [`engine/core/schema.ts` line 35](../engine/core/schema.ts)

Raised by `defineSchema` and `defineKind` (engine/core/schema.ts, engine/core/registry.ts) when a field is malformed: an unknown keyword (named with the closest one), an unknown type, a missing description, a default outside its own range or values, a minimum above the maximum, an empty enum, or a hook with neither a default nor `required: true`. `defineSettings` reports the same problems in a setting as `CORE_BAD_SPEC`.

### CORE_BAD_SETTING

- Message: `{problems}`
- Fix: give each setting a value of its type inside its range and values (node x describe setting <path> shows them); in a URL or with x set, write numbers plainly, booleans as true or false, and arrays or objects as JSON
- Registered in: [`engine/core/settings.ts` line 60](../engine/core/settings.ts)

Raised by `set`, `setText`, `load`, `fromUrl` and `override` (engine/core/settings.ts). A preset or a URL with any problem applies nothing, and every problem is listed at once.

### CORE_BAD_SNAPSHOT

- Message: `restore() got {what}, not a snapshot of this emitter`
- Fix: pass restore() what snapshot() of the same emitter returned: listeners are functions, which never move between emitters
- Registered in: [`engine/core/events.ts` line 44](../engine/core/events.ts)

### CORE_BAD_SPEC

- Message: `{where}: {problems}`
- Fix: give each field a value of its type inside its range and values, every required field, and no key the schema lacks (node x describe <kind> lists the fields)

- Fix: declare it with defineComponent({name}, { description, fields }) before an entity holds it (node x describe component lists the declared kinds)
- Registered in: [`engine/sim/state.ts` line 48](../engine/sim/state.ts)

Raised by the world (engine/sim/world.ts) and the hash (engine/sim/state.ts) for an entity property, a `spawn`, `add`, `remove` or `query` name, or a captured component that no `defineComponent` declared: the hash covers declared components only, so an undeclared one is refused rather than skipped.

## ui

### UI_BAD_DIALOG

- Message: `dialog.{call}: {problem}`
- Fix: say(text, { choices }) takes a string or a list of strings, and choices as a list of strings; update(dt) takes the frame's seconds, 0 or more
- Registered in: [`engine/ui/dialog.ts` line 35](../engine/ui/dialog.ts)

Raised by the dialog box (engine/ui/dialog.ts) for text that is not a string or a list of them, choices that are not, or a frame time that is not a number of seconds from 0.

### UI_BAD_DT

- Message: `update(camera, dt) got dt {dt}`
- Fix: pass the seconds since the last frame, 0 or more (the frame loop's dt)
- Registered in: [`engine/ui/overlay.ts` line 57](../engine/ui/overlay.ts)

### UI_BAD_MENU
